title: Hanasato Minori — All I've Felt〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: To One Day Reach that Flowery Stage

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'm so glad that the four of us got to watch the episode of Mr. Arimura's show we were on together!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (They showed us a lot more than I was expecting, and we've been getting a lot of responses on social media too!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I know we were just replacements, but I'm glad we decided to do our best!
Minori!
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hm? Hi, Michiko!
Morning!

rows.Speaker: Michiko
rows.Line: Morning! I had a feeling that we wouldn't get to see each other as much after being put in different classes, but not this much.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Sorry, I'm not actually at school a lot these days because of work and stuff...

rows.Speaker: Michiko
rows.Line: Oh, I saw you all on Arimura's show yesterday! I watched it together with my family!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
R-Really?!
Wh-What did you think...?!

rows.Speaker: Michiko
rows.Line:
We really enjoyed it!
Especially the fashion check segment. My big sister and I tried to predict who would win as we watched.

rows.Speaker: Michiko
rows.Line: And I picked you to win, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Michiko
rows.Line: But my dad got mad at me for cheering and shouting after you'd won.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha! You cheered that much? That kinda makes me happy.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Oh, Hanasato, I saw you on that show! I really liked the segment you girls came up with for the beginning...!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: I watched too, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Me three! I can't believe you got to appear on that show!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
No, uhh...! W-We just got lucky is all.
But thanks for watching!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
We saw it too.
Actually, we were just talking about it.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
Yeah!
The segment where you tried those souvenir snacks was really cute.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: C-Cute? I don't know about that... Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: We mean it! None of you sang or anything, but you all shined and dazzled like real idols!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Real idols...?!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-W-Wait! P-Please!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: My cheekbones will reach my ears from smiling so much if you keep showering me with praise like that!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
Haha!
You're so funny, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line: Oh, I bet a lot more people know about your group now because of that show!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?! I mean...
Th-That'd be really great!

rows.Speaker: Classmates
rows.Line:
Haha!
Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Humhumhuum♪

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(I can't believe so many people watched.
That makes me so happy...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm grinning like a little kid again.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But I'm really glad that they enjoyed it.

rows.Speaker: Audience Member A
rows.Line: And MORE MORE JUMP! is trying their best...

rows.Speaker: Audience Member B
rows.Line: But I still wish LiLia were here.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I really didn't know what to do after hearing them say that...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
(Oh, but...
If I didn't overhear them...)
Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh!
se_walk_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Morning, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Morning.
Is something on your mind? You seemed deep in thought.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! How did you know I was...?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. You were walking while staring at the ground. Also, you passed our classroom.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh no! You're right!
How did I end up in front of Class E?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So, what's on your mind?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, so! I was just thinking about that shoot we did and...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: ...which is why you were wondering what would've happened if you hadn't overheard them.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
That is a good question.
You may be right in thinking that they would've gone home fairly dissatisfied.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But I wouldn't worry too much since you're taking the time now to reflect upon what happened.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: At least now you sort of know what to do next time when we're faced with people who were expecting to see someone else.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, you're right! I know exactly what I need to do next time!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And don't forget to ask us for help then, okay?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe. Okay!
